Comments: Agriculture is a priority sector for Niger (over 40% of GDP); mobile apps for farmers mentioned in digital transformation context, but no documented integration into a government data exchange system.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Niger adopted a national e-Agriculture strategy (GIZ/FAO-supported, approved 2022) with a costed 2023-2027 action plan (22 projects, 37 actions) that explicitly aims for future data interoperability among agricultural platforms; existing platforms (SIMA, SIMB, RECA e-Extension, which had digitally profiled 24,000 farmers as of 2024) operate separately, with no unified farmer database or government data-exchange integration yet. This goes beyond mere planning, so the score is raised from Planned (2) to Under development (3); the original single source was too generic to support any specific score.

Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: Niger is building a national data center as part of its digital infrastructure plans, suggesting data sovereignty consciousness. However, no formal data localization law or sovereignty framework documented.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Contrary to the original comment, Niger does have a formal legal framework: Law 2017-28 (amended by Laws 2019-71, 2022-59 and 2023-31) on personal data protection covers all public and private-sector processing, including State bodies, establishes an independent Data Protection Authority (HAPDP) and restricts cross-border transfer of personal data to third countries absent adequate protection guarantees. No documented enforcement actions (fines, sanctions) were found, so controls are strong on paper but not demonstrably enforced. Raised from Limited controls (2) to Strong yet unenforced controls (3); the original source (an IXP article) did not address data sovereignty at all and is confirmed unrelated to this variable.
